title: Plum Lucky Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Plum Lucky is conveniently located behind the Ruskin Place Artist Colony and near the shops and restaurants of Central Square. Plum Lucky is a wonderfully appointed and decorated cottage.
description_expanded: Description109 WEST RUSKIN PLACE2 KING, 2 QUEEN, 1 BUNK, 1 TWIN - sleeps 11!Prime Seaside Location Near Central Square & Ruskin PlaceConveniently tucked just behind the iconic Ruskin Place Artist Colony and steps from the boutiques, galleries, and restaurants of Central Square, Plum Lucky truly lives up to its name. This unique Seaside vacation rental combines two beautifully appointed cottages—Plum Lazy and Plum Crazy—into one expansive coastal retreat, making it ideal for family reunions, multi-family vacations, or groups traveling together. Together, the homes offer approximately 2,700 square feet of living space, incredible outdoor areas, and a scenic tower with sweeping Gulf views—all in the heart of Seaside, Florida.Two Connected Cottages with Shared Outdoor LivingPlum Lucky is thoughtfully designed as two separate cottages connected by a shared open-air porch furnished with Adirondack seating—perfect for gathering while still enjoying privacy. Plum Lazy welcomes guests with a charming front porch featuring bistro seating for two, an ideal spot for morning coffee or people-watching along Seaside’s picturesque streets. Inside, the first floor features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen layout, complete with comfortable seating, a large flat-screen TV, and an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a full-size refrigerator. The adjacent dining area seats six comfortably, and a rear door leads directly to the shared porch between the homes.Upstairs in Plum Lazy, guests will find a king primary bedroom with a private ensuite bath (shower only), along with a second bedroom offering a queen bed and twin bed. These share a full hallway bathroom with a tub/shower combination, making this cottage well-suited for families.Plum Crazy: Elevated Living, Outdoor Spaces & Tower ViewsPlum Crazy adds another layer of space and flexibility to the Plum Lucky experience. On the first floor, there are two bedrooms, including a king primary suite with a mounted flat-screen TV and a spacious private bathroom featuring a dual vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower. The second bedroom includes a queen bed and shares a full hall bath with a charming bonus bunk alcove, complete with a privacy curtain—perfect for kids.The second floor of Plum Crazy is designed for gathering and entertaining. A fully equipped, updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances opens into a large living area with multiple sofas, a large smart TV, and a card table for four—ideal for family game nights. The dining area is surrounded by windows with treetop views and seats six, while the kitchen island offers bar seating for two more. A convenient half bath is located just off the kitchen.Balcony & Tower with Panoramic Gulf ViewsThe true highlight of Plum Crazy—and Plum Lucky as a whole—is its exceptional outdoor living. Just off the second-floor kitchen, an open-air balcony with Adirondack bar seating for four is wrapped in fragrant jasmine vines. From here, a spiral staircase leads to the covered observation tower, where bar seating for four invites you to take in panoramic views of Seaside’s rooftops, the Gulf of Mexico, and unforgettable sunsets. This elevated perch is the perfect place to end each day in Seaside.An Ideal Seaside Retreat for Groups & FamiliesWith its unbeatable location, flexible layout, and standout outdoor spaces, Plum Lucky offers a rare opportunity to stay together while still enjoying the charm of two distinct homes. Whether you’re gathering for a family celebration or simply soaking up the Seaside lifestyle with friends, this combined cottage retreat delivers comfort, character, and classic Seaside charm—just steps from the beach and Central Square. For additional options, Plum Lazy and Plum Crazy may be rented separately as 2-bedroom cottages.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, & Summer; 3-night minimum for Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURES2,700 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion4-minute walk (352 yards) to beach accessSmart TVs with apps including Netflix, Hulu, Apple TV, and moreSonos sound barTower with bar-top seating for four and stunning Gulf viewsAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts, 3 Pickleball courts, and a fitness center (court fees apply)Peacock Alley Linens – Fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered cars. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002137
